title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region residency + audit logging for customer keys
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Customers with regulatory requirements and enterprise contracts asked for enforceable KMS region residency controls and richer audit signals. This PR extends RBAC v2 policies to express KMS region pinning and ties policy enforcement into the KMS service and audit pipeline so operators can detect and block cross-region key operations. Changes included in this PR: 1) RBAC API: add optional policy predicate fields `kms_region_pin` (string or list) and `require_audit_log` (boolean) to role/resource bindings. 2) Key-management service: add an enforcement hook that validates `kms_region_pin` against the key's configured region on create/update/crypto operations and returns a clear denial reason when violated. 3) Audit logging: enrich KMS audit events with `policy_id`, `kms_region_pin`, `region_match` and add new event types `KMSRegionPinDenied` and `KMSRegionPinAudit` for denied and allowed-but-logged operations respectively. 4) Migration: background migration job that scans existing customer master keys (CMKs), annotates keys lacking region metadata with `region_pin: unknown`, and produces operator tickets to either annotate or rotate keys if residency must be enforced. 5) Console + docs: update RBAC editor UI to show new predicates, add documentation and a rollout checklist. 6) Tests: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests exercising KMS hooks, and an e2e canary to validate behavior in a single region. Rollout plan: feature-gated behind `enforce_kms_region_residency` account setting and `rbac_v2_kms_region_pin` feature-flag. We will canary in us-west-2 (small subset of orgs) for 48 hours, monitor audit events and denied operation rates, and then gradually enable for more orgs. Backout plan: disable feature flag and run migration to remove `require_audit_log` defaults. Checklist: - [x] Security review and threat modeling (SEC-987) - [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-2345) - [x] CI green (unit/integration/e2e canary) - [x] Feature-flag gated and safe default (off) - [x] Docs and console changes included Testing performed: unit and integration test suites, manual canary runs in staging and initial production canary, and load test for added policy check latencies (~2.5ms median per KMS op). No customer-visible API surface changes unless account enables enforcement. See linked tickets for rollout cadence.
